summary:
MarsPath Pro is an intelligent navigation system that we developed to help astronauts explore Mars safely. Our project aims to show astronauts the safest routes by combining satellite images, terrain information, and scientific data.
The biggest challenges on Mars are communication delays, dust storms, extreme temperatures, and unknown terrain conditions. To overcome these challenges, our system analyzes environmental data, identifies potential dangers, and suggests alternative routes when necessary. It also informs astronauts about risks through a green, yellow, and red warning system.
This project is important because it increases astronaut safety, reduces decision-making time, and helps make scientific explorations more efficient. Our goal is to make Mars exploration safer and easier.
details:
MarsPath Pro – Project Details

MarsPath Pro is an intelligent navigation system designed to help astronauts explore Mars safely. It analyzes satellite images, terrain maps, and scientific data to identify dangerous areas and suggest the safest routes. It also provides warnings about risks such as dust storms, rocky terrain, and steep slopes.

Our project aims to reduce risks, save time, and support astronauts in making quick decisions despite communication delays with Earth.

We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to develop the website interface. Our design focuses on creativity, safety, easy navigation, and the challenging environmental conditions of Mars.
